title: So, You Think You Know Emunctorology?
description: The ultimate precision challenge for the human-metabolic-SNP expert. Choose a category or play all topics.

questions.question: A patient is GSTM1 Null and GSTT1 Null. What is the primary clinical risk?
options: Inability to conjugate environmental carcinogens effectively

questions.question: The MTHFR C677T variant is most associated with what clinical marker?
What is the 'Methyl Trap' in the context of MTR/MTRR?
options: High levels of B12 in the blood
A state where folate is stuck as 5-MTHF because B12/MTR is non-functional

questions.question: Reduced P-glycoprotein (P-gp) production (MDR1 SNP) leads to:
options: Sustained higher drug levels in the bloodstream

questions.question: A CYP2D6 'Poor Metabolizer' will find which drug ineffective?
Slow Acetylators (NAT2) have a higher risk of what when taking isoniazid?
The ACE SNP primarily regulates what?
Low LPL (Lipoprotein Lipase) function typically manifests as:
options: Impaired triglyceride clearance and higher obesity risk

questions.question: The COMT Val158Met SNP affects the clearance of which chemicals?
The 'Explorer' genotype is characterized by a high prevalence of which genetic trait?
Which cofactor is la-essential for PPAR-gamma activity in fatty acid oxidation?
Who is at the HIGHEST risk for a severe Herxheimer reaction?
options: Slow acetylators with GSTM1/T1 Null alleles
